summary: Emera and Canadian Utilities agreed October 6, 2026 to a merger of equals creating a Top 20 North American utility with about $72 billion enterprise value, $45 billion rate base and six million customers. Emera holders are expected to own roughly 60% of the combined company (which will operate as Emera and keep Halifax headquarters), while Canadian Utilities holders receive about 40% and an approximately 20% expected dividend-income increase. ATCO will spin off a new industrial-services entity, and controlling holder Sentgraf signed a voting support agreement. Transaction is expected to be accretive to adjusted EPS in the first full year after closing; regulatory approvals and ATCO spin-off mechanics are key risk-arb watch items.
